Get to know Trinity

Rooted in faith.
Focused on your child.

Since 1954, Trinity Episcopal School has connected Christian character with academic excellence in Marshall, Texas.

Our purpose

Our Mission

is to educate and develop the whole individual in mind, body, and spirit in keeping with the love and teaching of Jesus Christ, our Lord and Savior.

Our future

Our Vision

is to be preparing children ages three through eighth grade for a successful future, both academically, spiritually, and socially. Through a diverse and well-rounded curriculum, we achieve that goal every single day with every single student.

Our story

A Marshall tradition
since 1954.

Trinity was founded to cultivate Christian character and excellence in education. The school is a mission of Trinity Episcopal Church in Marshall and serves children from age three through eighth grade.

Faith, learning, and community remain at the center of the school’s work. Trinity pairs a challenging curriculum with opportunities in fine arts, athletics, and spiritual development.

A history of accreditation

The school’s published history records initial Texas Education Agency accreditation in 1976, accreditation through the Southwestern Association of Episcopal Schools in 1989, and through the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools, now Cognia, in 2001.
